title: Abemi Beegadi Ezimbini
intro: Kwilizwe apho iintsikelelo zazininzi khona, uluntu lwalukhe lwanandipha ubutyebi beegadi ezimbini ezintle. Ubomi babo babubungqina bobubele bukaThixo, kodwa ibali labo latshintsha xa umbulelo uphela, nto leyo eyakhokelela kutshintsho olwaluza kuba luphawu oluhlala luhleli kubo bonke abacingisisayo.
clues: INkosi yethu yasinika iigadi ezimbini ezintle, eziluhlaza nezineziqhamo macala onke.
Sasiyalelwe ukuba sibulele, kodwa sakhetha ukungabi nambulelo saza sajika.
Idama elikhulu labamba amanzi anika ubomi emhlabeni wethu.
Xa saqhubeka nokwenza izinto ezimbi, idama laqhuma kwaye amanzi akhukula adlula.
Iigadi zethu ezazikade ziluhlaza zathatyathelw’ indawo ziziqhamo ezikrakra, imithana, kunye nemithi embalwa yelote.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Iigadi zethu zatshintshwa ziziqhamo ezikrakra nemithi enqabileyo
outcome.answer: Iigadi zethu zatshintshwa ziziqhamo ezikrakra nemithi enqabileyo

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
